## System Messages

### 3001 - 3015

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3001 - Unable to create list in TESTit (list is TESTit-disabled)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80001">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL attempts to create a list in TESTit 3 Server that already exists. The list create is rejected and the list remains unprotected in TESTit. The list is then reverted to TESTit Disabled in FLOWCAL

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3002 - TESTit request: Unable to enable/create (meter exists with different fluid phase)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80002">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL attempts to TESTit enable a meter based on a TESTit request, and is unable to do so because the fluid phase of the meter differs between FLOWCAL and TESTit

- Message Text: TESTit request: Unable to enable/create (meter exists with different fluid phase)
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Class: Informational
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80003">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3003 - TESTit request: Unable to enable (meter does not exist)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80003">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL attempts to TESTit enable a meter based on a TESTit request, and is unable to do so because the meter does not already exist in FLOWCAL.

- Message Text: TESTit request: Unable to enable (meter does not exist)
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Class: Informational
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3004 - TESTit request: Meter successfully enabled</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80004">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL successfully TESTit enables a meter based on a TESTit request.

- Message Text: TESTit request: Meter successfully enabled
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Class: Informational
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3005 - TESTit request: Request to enable meter received</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80005">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL receives a meter enable request from TESTit. In this case, no further action is expected, because the ‘Report’ option is selected in the TESTit Integrated Configuration screen.

- Message Text: TESTit request: Request to enable meter received.
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Class: Informational
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3006 - TESTit failed to process request: TESTit enabled meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80006">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to enable a meter in TESTit fails. The user may re-enable the meter in FLOWCAL to retry.

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: TESTit enabled meter
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Data 5: Meter failed to enable in TESTit. Re-enable meter in FLOWCAL to retry.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80007">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3007 - TESTit failed to process request: TESTit disabled meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80007">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to disable a meter in TESTit fails. The user may attempt to disable the meter in FLOWCAL again to retry.

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: TESTit disabled meter
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Data 5: Meter failed to disable in TESTit. Disable meter again in FLOWCAL to retry.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80008">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3008 - TESTit failed to process request: Update meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80008">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to update a meter in TESTit fails. Run ErrorQueueRetryMessage.ps1 to retry

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: Update meter
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Data 5: Meter failed to update in TESTit. Run ErrorQueueRetryMessage.ps1 to retry.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80009">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3009 - TESTit failed to process request: Delete meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80009">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to delete a meter in TESTit fails. The user may run the ErrorQueueRetryMessage.ps1 script to retry.

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: Delete meter
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Data 5: Meter failed to delete in TESTit. Run ErrorQueueRetryMessage.ps1 to retry.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80010">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3010 - TESTit failed to process request: TESTit enabled list</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80010">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to enable a list in TESTit fails. The user may re-enable the list in FLOWCAL to retry.

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: TESTit enabled list
- Message Data 1: LIST NAME
- Message Data 5: List failed to enable in TESTit. Re-enable list in FLOWCAL to retry.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80011">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3011 - TESTit failed to process request: TESTit disabled list</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80011">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to disable a list in TESTit fails. The user may attempt to disable the list in FLOWCAL again to retry.

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: TESTit disabled list
- Message Data 1: LIST NAME
- Message Data 5: List failed to disable in TESTit. Disable list again in FLOWCAL to retry.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80012">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3012 - TESTit failed to process request: Update list</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80012">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to update a list in TESTit fails. The user may run ErrorQueueRetryMessage.ps1 to retry.

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: Update list
- Message Data 1: LIST NAME
- Message Data 5: List failed to update in TESTit. Run ErrorQueueRetryMessage.ps1 to retry.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80013">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3013 - TESTit failed to process request: Delete list</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80013">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to delete a list in TESTit fails. The user may run the ErrorQueueRetryMessage.ps1 script to retry.

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: Delete list
- Message Data 1: LIST NAME
- Message Data 5: List failed to delete in TESTit. Run ErrorQueueRetryMessage.ps1 to retry.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80014">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3014 - TESTit failed to process request: Update meter analysis</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80014">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to update a meter analysis in TESTit fails. A new attempt to update the meter analysis will occur automatically on the next run of the FCSRVTESTITANALYSISSYNC service.

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: Update meter analysis
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Data 2: EFFECTIVE DATE
- Message Data 5: Meter Analysis failed to update in TESTit. A new attempt to update the meter analysis will occur automatically on the next run of the FcSrvTestITAnalysisSync service.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="80015">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3015 - TESTit failed to process request: Update flow average</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="80015">

This message is logged when FLOWCAL’s attempt to update a flow average in TESTit fails. The user may re-roll the meter for the desired time period in FLOWCAL to resend the flow average

- Message Text: TESTit failed to process request: Update flow average
- Message Data 1: METER NUMBER
- Message Data 2: EFFECTIVE DATE
- Message Data 5: Flow Average failed to update in TESTit. Re-roll meter for desired time period in FLOWCAL to resend flow average.
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

</div>
